title: An Annotated Corpus of Arabic Tweets for Hate Speech Analysis
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech targeted at religion or religious sects in Arabic tweets.
findings: In the created dataset of offensive Arabic tweets, hate speech targeting 'Religion or sect' was the fourth most common category, accounting for 13.51% of the targeted hate speech content. The paper provides 'All Muslims are terrorists' as an example of this category.
